metrics.summary:
Fixed `tomlkit.comment()` in tomlkit/api.py: when the string contains newlines, each line is now rendered as a comment — non-empty lines as `# <line>`, empty lines as a lone `#`. Single-line strings keep the previous `# ` prefix behavior, and the parser-produced comments (which already carry full `# ...` text and never contain newlines) are unaffected. Verified: `comment("line one
line two

line four")` on an empty document renders exactly `# line one
# line two
#
# line four
` and parses back unchanged; multi-line comments followed by real TOML content also round-trip. Ran the test suite: 319 passed (test_toml_tests.py fails collection both before and after the change due to a missing `tests/toml-test` data directory, unrelated to this fix).
